text:
emma: Hey team — FYI PR #41289 is blocked by a failing canary e2e in the merge queue, can someone quick-eye? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/41289 :eyes:
ci-bot: buildkite: pipeline/pr-41289 ➜ failed on step `e2e/canary-suite` (agent gpu-canary-7). Logs: `AssertionError: expected 200 but got 503`
jon: grabbing logs now, will paste the failing stack. If it's a transient infra 503 we can retry targeted run.
devon: looks like a nondeterministic webhook timeout in the canary test — we've seen similar flakiness when the mock service hits rate limits.
ci-bot: tail of failing test:
```
Error: request failed
    at src/tests/canary/webhook.test.ts:42:15
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:95:5)
AssertionError: expected 200 to equal 503
```
jon: thx. @sre-oncall any known canary infra blips on gpu-canary-7 around 18:05 UTC?
sre-oncall: We had a short autoscaler event at ~18:03 that caused a couple of agents to restart briefly — tracking in infra-incidents-ops. Should be stable now.
tara: If it's infra-caused we should rerun once before requiring a snapshot update. I'm happy to approve after a green targeted rerun. :+1:
emma: Can someone kick a targeted rerun for only the failing shard? I don't want to waste the whole matrix.
jon: running targeted rerun: `./scripts/ci/targeted_retry.sh --pr 41289 --tests e2e/canary-suite --shard 3` — started (buildkite #98765).
devon: also adding a quick guard to the test to tolerate transient 503s while we root-cause; will open a tiny follow-up PR if rerun is flaky.
ci-bot: buildkite: pipeline/pr-41289 ➜ started targeted build #98765 (shard 3)
ci-bot: buildkite: pipeline/pr-41289 ➜ succeeded on build #98765 (shard 3) ✅
jon: success on the targeted shard. All other required checks are passing.
tara: Great — giving LGTM for merge window. Anyone else want a look before I approve? :eyes:
devon: I can follow up with a quick postmortem and the small guard PR. No need to block this merge.
emma: Thanks all — I’ll merge once tara clicks approve. Scheduling merge for the next 10m window.
tara: Approved and merged. :shipit: Thanks for the quick coordination.
jon: noted: file a short note in the flaky-tests doc with steps (targeted retry command + observed autoscaler event).
devon: will do, adding links to infra incident and the follow-up PR.
ci-bot: buildkite: pipeline/pr-41289 ➜ merged to main (commit 4f8a2b1)
emma: leaving a thread in #postmortems with the brief root-cause and mitigation plan. Thanks everyone!
